### Beacon API standardization

https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1714#issuecomment-3277268595

### Impact to relays & mev-boost

* Will clients allow validators use third-party software like mev-boost & commit-boost?
    * If the answer is "no" what are the implications?
* Will builders operate builder (0x03) validators?
    * Alternatively, relays could operate validators where builders continue to submit payloads to relays, who then verify/publish the bid to the network on their behalf. For builders, this wouldn't require large changes on their part. At the very least, this would give builders more time to convert to the new system. It might continue to be useful for smaller builders who do not have sufficient capital.

Let's discuss some aspects of the epbs beacon api standardization [PR](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/552):
- `GET /validator/blocks/{slot}` will need some modifications since there's no longer a concept of blinded and unblinded blocks.  Options are to leave as `v3` and change the `ProduceBlockV3Response`  as briefly discussed in the PR [here](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/552#discussion_r2334612845) and on [discord](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1415070467446014143).  Alternatively, we could upgrade to a new `v4` endpoint
- do we need a new endpoint that can be used to signal creation and gossiping of `DataColumnSidecar` by whoever's bid is included in the consensus block or perhaps this can be triggered after the call to release a `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope`

I would love to discuss how the builder-api would evolve with ePBS. I have a brief doc on https://hackmd.io/XUQhAwAKRhi3vo4yFq13EQ but would like to understand how client teams are thinking of how offchain relays would look like with ePBS.
